verdict: feasible for conditional exact-real W pressure-input sensitivity, with explicit gates and no complete RHS bound
source: W interior pressure branch obtains getRdnTensor(CPU,FP32,nz), uses k index and scalar; capture actual tensor/values after fallback and actual gravity float at consumer, not FP64 EOS geometry approximation. Top separately reads getRdnwTensor(CPU,FP32,nz) at k-1.

Capture actual W cqw/cq1 consumer values and finite max or demonstrate exact dry zero, real selected canonical WRF mass-flux branch and Q/packing. Capture per-endpoint finite strictly positive level_mass_w and velocity_mass_w (or their proven conservative global minima) and actual map/alpha_w conditions; evaluate stored values at both original base and accepted trial, check accepted trial belongs to observed K/R.

Capture W S_inv block max and finiteness/positivity, correct W block start/size, packed layout N and source identity mask, ensure same fixed cloned scale at both endpoints. A scalar max is sufficient for conservative weighted bound, given correct counts, Q alias action and endpoint error bounds.

Cancellation of map/velocity factors is an exact-real input-sensitivity simplification, not a bound on native multiply/divide rounding. Actual coefficients must include branch/cq/mass and fallback values, verify finite/positive and sanitation mode.

Scoped capture can allocate/clone, synchronize and trigger diagnostics/A5 side effects and is terminal-only evidence; compare path and counters, no extra RHS/JVP, fail closed on missing, duplicate, partial capture or context mismatch.
Changing PressureEosContext layout is an ABI change: rebuild all consumers using identical header/macros, inspect link provenance, rerun affected checks.
limits: Quantities close selected-point coefficient/weight assumptions, not intermediate operation forward error, non-W components, whole RHS e_i, exact forcing, or descent.
Projected output alias multiplicities and independent/owned vs packed accounting must be explicitly checked; do not use unweighted norm as weighted S norm.
Initial plan only: no code edit, build, test, native or model run.
